content.value: Discuss the factors influencing the voltage output of a fuel cell. Explain how cell voltage varies with changing operating condition.

<sub>7(b)</sub> Derive the Butler-Volmer equation within the context of fuel cells and explain how this <sub>equation</sub> elucidates the kinetics of electrode reactions between current density and over potential.

<sub>7(c)</sub> Consider a <sub>hydrogen</sub> fuel cell with an exchange current density $( \mathrm { i } _ { 0 } )$ of $1 \times 1 0 ^ { - 5 } \mathrm { A } / \mathrm { c m } ^ { 2 }$ at room temperature (298K). Calculate the over potential (TJ) required to achieve a current density (i) of 0.001 A/cm2 for the hydrogen oxidation reaction. $[ \alpha = 0 . 5 ]$
<sub>8(a)</sub> What is cogeneration? Explain the design of a combined heat and power (CHP) fuel cell 12 system with necessary diagram.
